```artifact
@start
mode OfflineConsultation
  state PaymentSuccess
  state PaymentFailure
  state Error
  state Navigation
  state SymptomError

event PaymentSuccessEvent
event PaymentFailureEvent
event ErrorEvent
event NavigationEvent
event SymptomErrorEvent

guard PaymentSuccessGuard(paymentStatus)
  return paymentStatus == "success"

guard PaymentFailureGuard(paymentStatus)
  return paymentStatus == "failure"

guard ErrorGuard(errorMessage)
  return errorMessage.length > 80

guard NavigationGuard(navigationStatus)
  return navigationStatus == "success"

guard SymptomErrorGuard(symptom)
  return symptom.exists == false

@end
```
